attendance.note: Organiser-reported (DAAF Impact Report 2025): 15,538 physical Fair visitors plus 13,130 online Fair visitors, 28,668 in total. 2023: 'over 17,000 event visitors' per an Ian Potter Foundation case study (Google snippet).

audience.psychographics: Art collectors, cultural tourists and locals buying direct from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander art centres. In 2025, 40.7% of physical Fair visitors came from interstate and 2.3% from overseas; online visitors were 80.3% interstate and 16.8% overseas; 92% of visitors intend to return.
